title: Full-Text Search Across All Entities
acceptance_criteria: Search page with input field and debounced search (300ms)
Search queries SQLite using LIKE on movie title, tv series name, person name
Results grouped by type: Movies, TV Series, People
Each result shows: poster/profile image, title/name, type badge, rating
Results link to respective detail pages
Empty state when no results found
All text uses i18n translation keys
completion_summary: Implemented full-text search with debounced SearchBar, SearchResults, API route, DB queries, and i18n translations
